nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed/cleared by acceptOwnership.
mapping(address => uint) token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) ERC20 allowance table, written by approve and approveAndCall and decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply, fixed in the constructor to 100000000 * 10^18.
Token symbol string, set to CIFR in the constructor.
Token name string, set to 'CIFRCOIN TOKEN' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Owned constructor; sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner to the supplied address.
Transfers ownership to newOwner after require(msg.sender == newOwner) and clears newOwner.
Token constructor; initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-assigns the full balance to the deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls the arbitrary spender contract's receiveApproval callback before returning.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, refusing all plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that performs an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary tokenAddress.
Overflow-checked addition helper.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper.
Division helper with a zero-divisor require.
Caller-controlled address used in ownership checks, balance keys and allowance keys.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract.
Unchecked arithmetic: _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with no SafeMath guard.
address to parameter of transfer().
uint tokens parameter of transfer().
address spender parameter of approve().
address from parameter of transferFrom().
uint tokens parameter of transferFrom().
address tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf() and allowance().
uint tokens parameter of approveAndCall().
bytes data parameter of approveAndCall(), forwarded to the external callback.
address tokenAddress parameter of transferAnyERC20Token(), target of the external call.
address _newOwner parameter of transferOwnership().

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
msg.sender is the value written into owner during construction.
transferOwnership writes the new address into newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner to authorize transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the ownership handover.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) gates the ownership acceptance path.
Token constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value.
Token constructor assigns the symbol string.
Token constructor assigns the name string.
Token constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Constructor credits the whole supply into balances of the deployer address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply() performs unchecked subtraction, exposing the arithmetic unsafe operation.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer() delegates the sender balance decrement to safeSub, whose require guards underflow.
transfer() delegates the recipient balance increment to safeAdd, whose require guards overflow.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the debited account key.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom() reads and writes balances for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom() uses safeSub for the balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom() uses safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
transferFrom() keys the allowance lookup on msg.sender as spender.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall() invokes an arbitrary spender contract callback after writing state.
Control returns from the untrusted receiveApproval callback into approveAndCall, enabling reentrancy.
approveAndCall() uses msg.sender both for the allowance key and as the callback 'from' argument.
transferAnyERC20Token() calls an arbitrary token contract, which can call back into this contract.
The external ERC20 transfer call returns control to transferAnyERC20Token, the reentrancy return path.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before the privileged external call executes.
transfer() 'to' parameter is used as the credit key and event argument.
transfer() 'tokens' parameter is passed to safeSub/safeAdd and the Transfer event.
approve() 'spender' parameter keys the allowed mapping write.
transferFrom() 'from' parameter is debited in balances and allowed.
transferFrom() 'tokens' parameter is the amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd.
balanceOf() 'tokenOwner' parameter keys the balances lookup.
approveAndCall() 'tokens' parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
approveAndCall() 'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted callback.
transferAnyERC20Token() 'tokenAddress' parameter selects the external contract to call.
transferOwnership() '_newOwner' parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only feeds the transfer function's balance write and event.
The 'tokens' parameter only feeds the transfer function's safeSub/safeAdd operations.
The 'spender' parameter only keys the allowed mapping inside approve.
The 'from' parameter is only used as the debited account inside transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is only used as the amount inside transferFrom.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is only used as the balances lookup key in balanceOf.
The 'tokens' parameter is only used as the approved/forwarded amount in approveAndCall.
The 'data' bytes parameter is forwarded directly into the untrusted external callback.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter determines the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
The '_newOwner' parameter is only assigned to the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
